test_title: SSC Stenographer 2025 Official Paper (Held On: 08 Aug, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
In the following question, a sentence has been given in Indirect Speech. Choose the correct Direct Speech form.

The astronomer noted that Jupiter's rotation was the fastest among all planets in the solar system.

options.text: The astronomer noted, "Jupiter's rotation has been the fastest among all planets in the solar system."
The astronomer noted, "Jupiter's rotation had been the fastest among all planets in the solar system."
The astronomer noted, "Jupiter's rotation was the fastest among all planets in the solar system.
The astronomer noted, "Jupiter's rotation is the fastest among all planets in the solar system."

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Indirect Speech:** The astronomer noted that Jupiter's rotation was the fastest among all planets in the solar system.
 
• **Key Conversions:**
 
 
• **"was the fastest" remains "was the fastest"**
